top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic VeloCity Berlin's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.

Road-specific control matters at VeloCity Berlin. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 62 miles.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
62 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
VeloCity Berlin's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of VeloCity Berlin. Train it until it feels boring.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at VeloCity Berlin. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
At VeloCity Berlin, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what VeloCity Berlin's mixed terrain actually does to you.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Base fitness for VeloCity Berlin. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.

race_overlay.weather: August in Berlin, Germany — Early August in Berlin: typically warm, dry summer conditions. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before VeloCity Berlin. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for VeloCity Berlin's 62 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Road Specific, and VO2max to prepare you for 62 miles of mixed terrain in Berlin, Germany.
